fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Throws a knife drawn from a fold of cloth that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Opened Seam
fusions.desc: Slips up to 5 tiles to a target and cuts for 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Held in Sleeve
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeve Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade of thread: it increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
